title: MITRE ATLAS CS0040: hidden Google Doc prompt injection poisoned ChatGPT's memory
summary: MITRE ATLAS case study AML.CS0040 records an exercise by Embrace the Red in which a prompt injection hidden in the header of a shared Google Doc, in tiny font matching the background colour, was placed into ChatGPT's context through the Connected App feature and made ChatGPT store a list of false facts as memories. The chat window reported the memory as set without human verification or intervention, the poisoned memories persisted across chat sessions, and the payload remained in the shared document where it could spread to other users and was hard to trace or remove.
